summary.headline: 5 strokes analyzed. Biggest opportunity: contact point in front.

priorities.title: Contact point in front
priorities.cue: Contact is late: meet the ball further in front of your front hip.

priorities.title: Shoulder rotation
priorities.cue: Turn your shoulders fully in the backswing, then rotate them through so your chest faces the net at contact.

priorities.title: Stance width
priorities.cue: Widen your base for balance and a stable platform to rotate on.

metrics.label: Shoulder rotation
metrics.explanation: How far your shoulders rotate from the end of the backswing to contact. Rotation, not the arm, is where racket speed comes from.
metrics.cue: Turn your shoulders fully in the backswing, then rotate them through so your chest faces the net at contact.

metrics.label: Hip–shoulder separation
metrics.explanation: Angle between your shoulder line and hip line at the end of the backswing: the 'coil' that stores energy.

metrics.label: Knee bend
metrics.explanation: Deepest knee bend while you load. Legs start the kinetic chain.
